items.title: Optimizing learning for control of human-machine interfaces
items.author: Srikantan S. Nagarajan, Preeya Khanna
items.content: <article>Human-machine interfaces, such as augmented reality devices, hand prostheses, and brain-computer interfaces, are increasingly being used in neurorehabilitation. In this issue of Neuron, Vassiliadis et al. examine the interaction between closed-loop continuous reinforcement and sensory feedback in learning of human-machine interface control.</article>

items.title: Running in reverse: Tau redirects mitochondrial electron flow toward neurodegeneration
items.author: Ahmed Atwa, Marco A. Perez, Nicholas M. Kanaan
items.content: <article>In this issue of Neuron, Li et al. show that tau enters mitochondria and binds NDUFS3 to regulate reverse electron transport (RET) in a phosphorylation-dependent manner. RET promotes tau phosphorylation, forming a self-perpetuating loop that is exacerbated with stress and tauopathy.</article>
